Failing-first contract test re-derives trigger scope, proves an unrelated-path main push is accepted and PR path behaviour unchanged; exact-SHA checker still rejects a stale success; negative control fails when the push path filter is reinstated.
Focused tests, validate.py and the full suite (4 CI-equivalent shards, all exit 0) before commit; badges regenerated; clean commit, no trailers; manifest with intent and lighting lit; stop at BUILT.

intent.goal: Let every main SHA start the install workflow so release_check gate 4 can find an install success at the exact release HEAD.
intent.ruled_out: Weakening check_workflow_green_at_head to accept the latest success on any SHA; adding unrelated paths (assets/**) to the push filter, which would still skip future unlisted paths; changing the PR path gate or the job.
intent.why: GitHub runs a push workflow only when branches AND paths both match; video-only e7089cbf matched no path, so no run exists at that HEAD and the newest install success is stale at 284a3d81 — gate 4 is unsatisfiable by construction until the filter goes.
